title: Support custom Resend sender (resend_from) + notify config in init/config UI
description:
Wire a configurable sender address for escalation emails, and make the [notify] config settable through `cam init` and `cam config` (today it only works by hand-editing project.toml).

## Problem
1. `sendEscalation` accepts an optional `from`, but every call site omits it, so it always falls back to the hardcoded default `cam <onboarding@resend.dev>` (src/notify/resend.ts:74). `readResendConfig` (src/config/models.ts:185-205) only returns `{ apiKey, recipient }`. Adding `resend_from` to `[notify]` in project.toml is currently dead config — nothing reads it.
2. There is no UI path for the [notify] config at all. Neither `src/ui/InitScreen.tsx` (cam init) nor `src/ui/ConfigScreen.tsx` (cam config) surfaces recipient/from — the operator must hand-edit project.toml.

## Scope
### A. resend_from plumbing
- Add `from: string` to `ResendConfig` (empty string when unconfigured).
- Read `resend_from` from `[notify]` in `readResendConfig` (non-secret, TOML is the source; mirror the `resend_recipient` pattern).
- Plumb `from` through every `sendEscalation` call site in src/commands/sidecar.ts (~8: buildShipEscalateFn, buildToolchainEscalateFn, drain, plan-runner/loop production escalate fns, etc.). When `resend_from` is empty, keep the existing `onboarding@resend.dev` default (pass undefined so the resend.ts:74 fallback fires) — zero behavior change for projects that do not set it.

### B. init / config UI
- `cam init` (src/commands/init.ts + src/ui/InitScreen.tsx): allow setting `resend_recipient` and `resend_from` during setup; write them to the `[notify]` table in project.toml.
- `cam config` (src/commands/config.ts + src/ui/ConfigScreen.tsx): surface the same `[notify]` fields for editing after init (fits the CAM-87 tabbed-UI direction — cross-reference, do not block on it).
- HARD CONSTRAINT: the API key MUST NOT be written to project.toml. project.toml is git-tracked and the repo is public. The canonical source is the `RESEND_API_KEY` env var / `.env` (readResendConfig already prioritizes env over TOML, comment: "canonical, not git-tracked"). If init/config touches the key at all, it writes to `.env` (gitignored) or just shows configured/unconfigured status — never to project.toml.

## Tests
- readResendConfig returns configured `from`; empty/missing `resend_from` yields '' and the default sender is used.
- init/config write path emits `resend_recipient`/`resend_from` into `[notify]` and never writes `resend_api_key` into project.toml.

## Notes
- Custom sender requires the domain to be verified in the Resend account. Operator (Eduardo) confirmed `radiologic.io` is verified; intended sender is `caminha@radiologic.io`. Recipient stays `caminhae@gmail.com`.
- Deferred: operator asked to file this but leave Resend as-is for now (default sender stays live). Backlog, not this cycle.
- Quality gates: `bun run typecheck`, `bun test`, `bun run check:all`.
